-1_1_0.name: High Priestess
-1_1_0.description: A brilliant but exhausted woman in robes gone thin at the elbows.
traits: Views her duties as a chore

hints.Luminaria: A city of drifting memories and eternal light, though the light is getting dimmer.
hints.High-Level Spells: The great works require Phoenix-Ash, Stellar-Ichor, or Void-Pearls, though the exact ratios are a secret I'm too tired to explain.
hints.Meditation: At the Temple of Radiance, you may meditate. 50 Virtue can be exchanged for a permanent +1 to any attribute. Try not to make it a habit; I have other things to do.

0_2_0.name: Lord Raika
0_2_0.description: A man draped in excessive silks, eyes glazed and a gold goblet permanently in hand.

hints.City State: Something about taxes? Or was it a parade? I can't recall. Just make sure the wine keeps flowing.
hints.Audiences: You may 'confer' your deeds with me once per day - new floors walked and last stands fought. I grant up to three virtue. Then send the wine cart.

2_-1_0.name: Barnaby the Tinker
2_-1_0.description: A twitchy man surrounded by coils of rope and iron tools.

hints.Gremlins: I've heard they can reach right through your skin! They eat the food straight out of your stomach while you're still walking! Absolute nightmares!

-1_-1_0.name: Mistress Valerica
-1_-1_0.description: A woman with a commanding presence, wearing a corset that seems to defy physics.

hints.Accommodations: I have rooms for the weary... and 'private' suites in the back for those seeking a different kind of relaxation. For a price, of course.

1_-1_0.name: Xylos the Archivist
1_-1_0.description: A spindly man with ink-stained fingers and spectacles that magnify his eyes to an alarming size.

hints.Low-Level Spells: I can teach you the basics—Cure Light Wounds, Light, or Sleep—if you have the coin. The recipes are simple enough for a novice.
hints.Advanced Magic: Many mages took their greatest secrets down into the dungeons. If you seek the lost arts, look among the ruins below.
hints.Dungeon Lore: The ruins below are fickle. Forgiveness shrines can wipe your sins (reset Virtue to 0), while Anti-Shrines allow those with -50 Virtue to gain power. Fascinating, really.

0_0_0.name: The Town Crier
0_0_0.description: A man with a massive bell and a voice that echoes through the square.

hints.News: Hear ye! Hear ye! Something happened yesterday! I forget what, but it was definitely important!

0_1_0.name: Captain Halloway
0_1_0.description: A guard in dented mail with a posture so straight it looks painful.

hints.Castle Entry: Form 12-B must be signed in triplicate before you may approach Lord Raika. Rules are the only thing keeping this city from chaos!

1_0_0.name: Slippery Pete
1_0_0.description: A man in a patched cloak who seems to be constantly looking over his shoulder.

hints.Rare Goods: Psst. Want some authentic Dragon Scales? Fresh from the peaks! (They look suspiciously like oversized carp scales).
hints.Lockpicks: Need a lockpick, friend? I'm the only honest man in the market who sells 'em. Don't tell the others.

1_-2_0.name: Alchemist Zale
1_-2_0.description: A jittery man with stained fingers and a scorched leather cap.

hints.Potions: I sell by color, dear Protector! Red for the flesh, Green for the venom, Blue for the blight. Simple as that!
hints.Curing Poison: A Green Potion is the fastest way, but if you're handy with reagents, a mix of Charcoal, Sage, and Silver Dust does the trick.

2_0_0.name: Ma Baker
2_0_0.description: A round, cheerful woman perpetually dusted in white flour.

hints.Life Advice: Life is like a sourdough, dearie; you've got to let the troubles rise before you can bake them into something sweet!
hints.Hunger: A hungry belly makes for a weak sword, dearie. Keep your satiety up, or you'll start wasting away!

2_1_0.name: Silas the Stablemaster
2_1_0.description: A rugged man who smells of hay and old leather.

hints.Horses: Horses don't lie. Humans lie. I'll take a stallion over a senator any day of the week.

0_-1_0.name: Sentry Pip
0_-1_0.description: A young guard whose helmet is slightly too large for his head.

hints.The Dungeon: I... I don't go in there. I've heard the walls breathe. Also, some say there are 'Anti-Shrines' down there that empower the wicked, and 'Forgiveness Shrines' for those who've lost their way. Terrifying!

1_1_0.name: Master Thorne
1_1_0.description: A burly man with arms like tree trunks and a permanent scowl of concentration.

hints.Forging: The secret to a true blade is the fold, not the fire.
hints.Equipment: I can repair your gear, but only if you bring the materials.

3_0_0.name: Elias the Fletcher
3_0_0.description: A meticulous man with a magnifying lens perched on his forehead.

hints.The Perfect Shot: It's all in the fletching. A single millimeter of deviation in the feather and your arrow is just a very expensive stick.
